{{Quote|I'm a tired bounty hunter and my patience is lacking. I've been so consumed with killing the Tuskens that I've been left empty, exhausted. But I must destroy them... it is my destiny.|Vi'conya T'ili, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:VT" />}}
'''Vi'conya T'ili''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|It's a painful subject, but if you must know: the Tuskens destroyed my family and I have brought it upon myself to rid Tatooine of their worthless existence.|Vi'conya T'ili, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:VT" />}}
Vi'conya T'ili was native to the planet Tatooine. Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], her family was killed by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. She remained deeply traumatized by the loss of her family and vowed to rid Tatooine of the Tuskens.<ref name="SWG:VT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Vi'conya T'ili resided in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] named [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. While there, she encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. At first, she was suspicious of the spacer, and even accused the individual of allying with the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tuskens]]. However, her suspicions and threatening remarks subsided when she learned that the spacer was actually interested in eliminating some Tuskens. She then offered the spacer the whereabouts of two locations on Tatooine, including [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]], and the [[Tusken Village]] in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]].<ref name="SWG:VT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vi'conya T'ili was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:VT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vi'conya T'ili was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref> In the game, players may speak to her to obtain the locations of two Tusken Raider hot spots.<ref name="SWG:VT" />
